cards.title: Conflux
powers: {Conflux} deals 1 target 2 damage of a type of your choice.
incapacitatedAbilities: One player may play a card.
One hero may use a power.
One player may draw a card.

openingLines.default: Let us see if you can handle all I have!

cards.title: Power Crystal
body: Increase damage dealt by {Conflux} by 1 for each different type of damage {Conflux} has dealt this turn.
At the start of your turn, {Conflux} may deal themselves 1 irreducible psychic damage. If {Conflux} takes no damage this way, destroy this card.

cards.title: Negabolt
body: {Conflux} deals 1 target 2 infernal damage. If a target dealt damage this way has 2 or fewer HP, destroy it.
Play a card now or {Conflux} deals 1 target 3 infernal damage.

cards.title: Flarebolt
body: {Conflux} deals 1 target 2 fire damage. Draw 1 card.
Play a card now or {Conflux} deals 1 target 3 fire damage.

cards.title: Snowbolt
body: {Conflux} deals 1 target 2 cold damage. {Conflux} gains 2 HP.
Play a card now or {Conflux} deals 1 target 3 cold damage.

cards.title: Lightning and Thunder
body: {Conflux} deals 1 target 3 lightning damage.
{Conflux} deals each non-Hero target 1 sonic damage.
Draw 2 cards.

cards.title: Prey and Spray
body: {Conflux} deals 1 target 3 radiant damage.
{Conflux} deals each non-Hero target 1 toxic damage.
You may use a power now.

cards.title: Echoed Blast
body: After the first time {Conflux} deals a target damage each turn, {Conflux} may deal a target 2 damage of the same type.

cards.title: Channel Essence
body: When this card enters play, {Conflux} deals regains 3 HP.
At the end of your turn, draw cards equal to the number of different types of damage {Conflux} has dealt this turn. If 3 or more cards are drawn this way, destroy this card.

cards.title: Intercepting Shot
body: If {Conflux} would be dealt damage by a non-Hero target, prevent that Damage and {Conflux} may deal 1 target 2 Energy Damage, increased by the amount of damage prevented by this card.
Then, destroy this card.

cards.title: Eye of the Vortex
body: When this card is destroyed, you may destroy up to 3 ongoing or environment cards.

cards.title: Extra Arms
body: You may use an additional power during your power phase.

cards.title: Overwhelming Blast
body: Damage dealt by {Conflux} is irreducible.

cards.title: Gathered Vigor
body: Each Hero gains the following power:

[b]Power:[/b] This hero deals themselves 2 psychic damage. Reveal cards from the top of your deck until a Limited card is revealed. You may put this card either into your hand or into play. Shuffle the rest of the revealed cards your deck.

cards.title: Cascade Blast
body: After you use a power, {Conflux} may deal 1 target X energy damage, where X = the number of different types of damage {Conflux} has dealt this turn times 2.
If damage is dealt this way, destroy this card.
